correctness.rationale: Partition into exact nonzero supports. Each connected component of the induced graph assigns projective lines through the orthogonal involution: P1 if bipartite, degree-two etale isotropic scheme if nonbipartite. Punctured tautological line bundles give (L-1)^{|U|}, so motivic additivity proves the stated identity. The etale quadratic square relation and Frobenius eigenvalues yield counts and the Euler product. Fifty-seven finite-field graph cases and 380 complete-graph symbolic cases are corroborative only.

value.rationale: A natural and infinite family of algebraic varieties associated with every graph gets an explicit motif class and all finite-field extension counts by a single bipartiteness/odd-cycle graph polynomial. The quadratic-etale parameter records genuinely arithmetic split-versus-nonsplit information invisible after algebraic closure; the complete-graph specialization exhibits a sharp growth-degree change for h>=4. This is more than a finite computation or a renaming of existing component counts.
